title: Outcome
description: Canonical factual outcome record schema for the 14-day post-assignment evaluation window. Contains only observed factual draw, never potential outcomes or true uplift.

customer_id.description: Foreign key matching the exposure record.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identifier matching the exposure record.

y_transacted.description: Binary factual conversion outcome (1 if customer transacted during the outcome window, 0 otherwise).

txn_count_window.description: Count of transactions within the 14-day outcome window. Must be strictly 0 when y_transacted is 0; >= 1 otherwise.

txn_amount_window_bdt.description: Total transaction volume in BDT within the outcome window. Must be strictly 0 when y_transacted is 0; > 0 otherwise.

window_start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking the start of the outcome window (identical to assigned_at).

window_end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking the end of the 14-day outcome window.
